gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Aaargh opens the eye of its e generously, with bowls and stems drawn at a single weight, and it hits hard. Stint Ultra Expanded, the text serif, floats apart like pipe cleaners.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text sounds literary, with a wide visible entrance into every curve. Amadeus stretches its words wide across the line, while paragraphs in the text serif settle in with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-faustina: Classic and authoritative in tone, the body sits quietly under Azonix, whose wide-mouthed letters stay crisp even shrunk. Faustina thins its bowls gracefully, and its open-jawed c looks like a pair of pliers.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-esteban: Fat, round and loud, Bloody packs its lowercase with big bowls. Esteban stays refined, its thin parts barely slimmer than its stems, and its wide e never squeezes shut.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-headland-one: Headland One spaces its letters well apart, never risking a touch. Bloody shouts with big round lowercase bowls, and the gently varied strokes below keep everything dignified and quiet.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Bloody is all big round bowls and brash confidence. Hedvig Letters Serif sits underneath with open-ended curves and a faint nib-pressure variation, a sturdy, authoritative counterweight to all that roundness.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-lisu-bosa: Bloody goes for big, round lowercase bowls and low contrast. That one makes the statement, while Lisu Bosa, the text serif, lets its counters spill into the surrounding space.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with a gentle taper from stem to joint and a generous middle band. Bloody supplies the round, loud opening, and Ovo, the text serif, can drop to a modest size without thinning out.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-domine: Domine reads refined and dignified, with compact ascenders, breathing room inside each curve and a slight pinch where bowls meet stems. Bushcraft wanders loose above it, all spaghetti strokes.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab, the text serif, has a visibly gaping c that holds at any size. Epunda Slab makes the pair work by opening up exactly where Capture It, with its nearly sealed letters, closes down.
